title: Monotonicity of randomized time
statement: Let $T_1,T_2 : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ satisfy $T_1(n) \le T_2(n)$ for every $n$. Then every language in $\mathrm{RTIME}(T_1)$ belongs to $\mathrm{RTIME}(T_2)$, where membership means that a finite randomized machine halts on every branch within a constant multiple of the time bound, accepts members with probability at least $2/3$, and never accepts nonmembers.
